bell.label: Notifications
bell.title: Notifications
bell.failed: We could not load your notifications.
bell.empty: Nothing yet. Submissions, results and season news land here.

model.title: There is no model with that id.
model.body: A model's address is its id, and every page that names a model links to it. The leaderboard and the match pages are the surest way back to one.

hints.value: The id is truncated or mistyped. It is a uuid, and each character counts.
It belongs to another deployment, or nobody made the model.

version.title: There is no version with that id.
version.body: The id has the right shape, but it names no version we hold. A version id is a permalink that never moves or expires, so this one never existed here.

hints.value: Someone wrote the link by hand, or dropped a character copying it.
It belongs to a different deployment of TinyBrains.

match.title: There is no match with that id.
match.body: Each match keeps its id for good, played or cancelled, so we never scheduled this one.

hints.value: Open the version you were reading about and use its list of matches.

profile.title: Nobody here goes by that name.
profile.body: Each account gets a profile when it first signs in, entered or not. This handle has not signed in, or you spelled it differently. Capitalisation does not matter, and the rest of the spelling must match.

season.title: There is no season by that name here.
season.body: A season's address is its slug, as in `?season=summer-2026`, and it never changes. A private season shows only to its participants and its admins, once they are signed in.

hints.value: The slug is mistyped, or the season belongs to another game: pick it in the header's switcher instead.

hints.key: If it is a private season
hints.value: Sign in with the account its admins added. Nobody else can see it, so it looks the same as a season that does not exist.

route.title: That page is not part of this site.
route.body: Some early links pointed at pages we have since removed. You pick games and seasons in the header's switcher: the home page in a past season is `/?season=summer-2026`, and the leaderboard for one game is `/leaderboard?game=ants`.

hints.value: Open the home page and pick the game and season you wanted; the address you land on is the one to keep.

api.title: We could not reach the API.
api.body: The page exists, and what you asked for is most likely there, but the API did not answer. You have lost nothing: the database holds versions, ratings and finished matches, and this page holds none of them.
api.unreachable: We could not reach the API.
api.notJson: The API answered with something that is not JSON.

inline.unreachable: {what} did not load because the API did not answer. The list may hold entries you cannot see.

noSeason.title: {game} has no season yet.
noSeason.body: There is nothing to rank or watch until the first season opens. Get started now, and your model is ready to enter when it does.

crash.title: This page stopped drawing.
crash.body: This site failed to draw what the API sent. You have lost nothing: the database holds versions, ratings and finished matches, and this page holds none of them.
crash.moreHeading: If it keeps happening on one page
more: The other pages most likely still work, because each has its own code.
The bug is ours. Tell us on Discord or GitHub, with the message below.

signIn.body: Sign in to see this. Your sign-in is your account, with nothing else to create.

admin.title: This page is for administrators.
admin.bodySignedIn: Your account is not an administrator. Administrators reach these pages from their account menu.
admin.bodySignedOut: Sign in with an administrator account to use it.

classes.iconMemory: {class} class, up to {cap}, memory {flat} + {cell} B a cell

memory.label: Memory
memory.hint: What a model of each class may carry from one turn to the next: the first number on every board, plus the second for each of the board's cells. 0 and 0 is no memory. At most 262,144 and 16.

marks.provisional: Provisional: this rating is still settling
marks.sparkline: rating over the last {n} counts: {first} to {last}

cap.unmeasured: Admission has not measured it yet; that measurement decides the class.
cap.noCap: We have no class cap on record for this version, so there is nothing to measure it against.
cap.over: Over the cap by {size}, so admission refused it.

matchRows.trialTip: Trial: a new version's first match

matchRows.error: We could not load the matches, so there may be some this list does not show.

ladder.emptyClosedOpen: No version earned a rating in this season.
ladder.emptyClosedClass: Nothing entered the {class} class in this season.
ladder.emptyLive: No version has a rating in this season yet. [Be the first →](/start)
ladder.emptyLiveClass: No version has a rating on {class} yet. Fit model and manifest in {cap} and yours would lead it. [Get started →](/start)
ladder.emptyLiveClassMemory: No version has a rating on {class} yet. Fit model and manifest in {cap}, with memory {flat} + {cell} B a cell, and yours would lead it. [Get started →](/start)

plot.caption: Each version on this ladder, plotted by its rating against its measured size on a logarithmic scale, over bands for the season’s weight classes. Each mark links to its version’s page, and the ladder’s table holds the same rows.
plot.empty: nothing rated on this ladder yet

replay.noneCancelled: Cancelled before it started, so there is nothing to replay.
replay.nonePending: Runners have not played this match yet.
replay.noneMissing: We have no stored replay for this match.
replay.loadingBody: The cartridge re-simulates the match from the recorded actions.
replay.unavailableBody: This deployment is not serving the game's viewer bundle. Run `npm run vendor:viewers` and rebuild. The match, its seats and its scores still show above.
replay.unbundled: No viewer for this match's engine
replay.unbundledBody: Another engine's viewer would draw a match that never happened, so none is drawn. The result and the scores stand.
replay.failed: We could not show the replay
replay.failedBody: The viewer stopped before it could draw.
replay.boardFailed: We could not draw the board
